metric_definitions.A_final_answer_accuracy: Share of tasks with correct final answer (auto v1.2 or human decision). Independent of tool-set.
metric_definitions.B_exact_tool_set_success: Share of tasks where predicted invoke set exactly equals gold set.
metric_definitions.C_strict_overall_task_success: answer correct AND exact tool set AND all invocations successful AND dependency OK when applicable AND refusal OK when applicable AND evidence correct or N/A.

note: A, B, and C are separate metrics and must not be substituted for each other.
